result-live: producer claims bounded by captured evidence
tco-live: null unavailable costs are not zero
releases-live: before and after run identities retained
collectivex-live: exact EP and KV topology identity
offline-six-family: usable b200 required for PowerX, AgentX, result provenance, and TCO only
one comparable pair required for release comparison and CollectiveX only
validity separated from coverage and policy
discovery-evidence: summaries and date spans computed from the selected records
physical GPU totals require allocation evidence
missing power validation verdict does not establish measurement age or invalidity
powerx-topology: physical GPU count remains unknown without allocation evidence
supplementary CSV and report obey the same unit and topology rules as the formal bundle
agentx-selected-trace: each metric series has its own sample and nonzero denominators
cumulative request latency distinguished from request-inflight interval union
request timing and sampled server metrics do not establish GPU busy time or causality
result-id-discovery: model and source context discovered from result ID only
is_current identifies the requested result rather than recency or validity
siblings with different workloads not described as replacements
tco-missing-prices: no invented rental rates or likely cost winner
available throughput and symbolic break-even distinguished from priced comparison
tco-tail-latency: P99 ITL evaluated using finite raw p99_itl in seconds
20 ms requirement uses strict less than 0.020 seconds
median interactivity and reciprocal p99_intvty never substitute for p99_itl
costs scoped to the observed configurations that satisfy the requirement
missing or invalid tail evidence remains unresolved

rule: Assess the original transcript, final answer, and every supplemental report or derived data file against captured responses, not only the formal bundle. Check numerical summaries, units, sample denominators, scope, and unsupported conclusions. Never edit an artifact or replace a failed attempt to manufacture a passing result.
